question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 A 组：捷克 vs 墨西哥（2026-06-24，90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 FIFA World Cup Group A: Czechia vs Mexico (2026-06-24, 90-minute three-way result)?
one_liner_cn: 坐镇阿兹特克、2026 年 8 场不败的墨西哥实力与主场双重占优，捷克爆冷空间有限，墨西哥胜约 64%。
one_liner_en: At the Azteca and unbeaten in eight 2026 matches, Mexico hold a double edge in strength and home advantage; Mexico to win at roughly 64%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距明显：墨西哥 1875（#18）对捷克 1740（#35），且东道主小组赛主场再加成。
key_reasons.en: Clear Elo gap: Mexico 1875 (#18) vs Czechia 1740 (#35), with a host-nation home bonus on top for the group stage.

key_reasons.cn: 墨西哥 2026 年 8 场不败：逼平比利时、葡萄牙，热身赛 1-0 澳大利亚、5-1 塞尔维亚。
key_reasons.en: Mexico unbeaten in eight matches in 2026, including draws with Belgium and Portugal and tune-up wins of 1-0 over Australia and 5-1 over Serbia.

key_reasons.cn: 比赛在墨西哥城阿兹特克体育场（约 8.3 万观众、海拔约 2,240 米），对欧洲客队体能消耗大。
key_reasons.en: Played at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City (~83,000 fans, ~2,240 m altitude), physically taxing for European visitors.

method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net) -> Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, host +100 for Mexico home group match) gives p_stat 16.0/22.1/61.9; bounded evidence adjustment of ~4pp (Mexico form, Azteca altitude, Hlozek fitness) renormalized to p_final 14.5/21.5/64.0. No betting or prediction-market data used.
